cost.detail: Local CPU only: three full ablation passes over the recovered sentences, seven mutation clones, four preflight runs. No rental, no CI dispatch, no fetch.

subagents._why: One instrument, edited in one place at a time; every measurement had to read the tree the previous edit produced. A seat would have been a second writer for no parallelism.

what_i_got_wrong: I REPORTED '19 of 22 already watched' AND IT WAS WRONG, BECAUSE MY OWN FIX HAD MADE A FALSE RED POSSIBLE. Letting the locator cross a stripped construct meant the span handed to `ablate` could contain `<sup>16</sup>` or `<!--PMID:…-->`, and `ablate` perturbs every digit run it is given — so a mutated CITATION NUMBER could turn a citation guard red and the SENTENCE would be reported bound while its own number stayed unwatched. Corrected reading: 14 RED, 4 BLIND, 4 stating no number the census covers. A false BLIND wastes a session; a false RED retires a real gap.

AND MY FIRST VERSION OF THE LOCATOR WAS WRONG IN A WAY ONLY THE NUMBERS SHOWED. I inlined three patterns into one alternation and scoped the flags of only two, so `^`/`$` in the dropped-line branch anchored to the ends of the whole file. 9 of 15 sentences stayed unlocatable. A pattern inlined without its flags is a different pattern, and reading it again would not have found it.

A GUARD I WROTE PASSED ITS OWN FIRST MUTATION TEST AND WAS STILL TOO WEAK. `assert "six-nucleotide DNA gap" in flat` proves an occurrence EXISTS; the article states it twice and `16-mer` four times, so mutating the other site left it green. It now asserts the SET of stated values, re-tested at all six sites.

I ALMOST REGISTERED AN EXEMPTION IN A DOCUMENT THAT HAD NO GATE. The exemption guard refused it and was right: response-endpoint-indolent-tumours.md carried no COVERAGE_FLOOR, so an 'exemption' there exempted a sentence from nothing. Adding the floor immediately failed the ablation gate on '552 arms from 138 trials' — the Results sentence, the denominator every rate in the paper divides by, watched by nothing. A document that was never gated is not a document that passed.
